rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something literally on the surface or concerned only with the outward surface rather than the substance.

example.english: The wooden board has some superficial scratches.
example.traditional: 塊木板表面有幾道淺淺嘅刮痕。
example.jyutping: faai3 muk6 baan2 biu2 min6 jau5 gei2 dou6 cin2 cin2 ge3 gwaat3 han4

rows.note: Use this when criticizing an analysis, understanding, idea, or person as lacking depth or substance.

example.english: Your analysis is too superficial and does not address the causes at all.
example.traditional: 你呢個分析太膚淺，完全冇講到原因。
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 fan1 sik1 taai3 fu1 cin2 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 gong2 dou3 jyun4 jan1

rows.note: Use this for something that seems true or real at first glance, especially when the fuller reality is different.

example.english: Everyone seems to be getting along on the surface, but the peace is superficial and there are still many problems underneath.
example.traditional: 表面上大家都相安無事，其實背後仲有好多問題。
example.jyutping: biu2 min6 soeng6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 soeng1 on1 mou4 si6 kei4 sat6 bui3 hau6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 man6 tai4
